text:
Iris: quick flag from guerrilla testing 1: toolbar actions are ambiguous. users can't tell if 'Preview' targets one function or the whole run.
Jon: saw that too. idea: keep visible verb short ('Run'/'Preview') and add a tiny scope pill that says 'selection' or 'all'. collapse to a chevron on narrow widths.
Priya: accessibility nits: icon-only 16px buttons are problematic. require aria-labels, 24px hit target, and a visible focus ring with 3:1 contrast.
Marco: implementation note 1 the editor toolbar lives in Monaco iframe. we'll need a small postMessage bridge for keyboard focus + shortcuts. prefer short visible labels + aria-describedby tooltips to avoid layout breakage.
Iris: copy tweak: run history wording 'Ran 3s ago' confuses people. prefer 'Completed 3s ago' when finished and 'Running (3s)' when active.
Jon: function-def placeholder 'args: {}' reads as required empty object. change to 'Example args: {"user_id": 42}' and add muted helper 'JSON or YAML examples accepted'. also add an 'Insert example' quick action.
Priya: status chips need non-color cues. add icon + text like 'Succeeded'/'Failed' and an aria-live region to announce changes.
Marco: perf: lazy-load SVG sprite after 50 history items or when list is interacted with; for very long lists render simple text chips first and swap icons in viewport.
Iris: plan: split into two PRs: PR A = a11y infra (aria labels, focus trap, aria-live) + postMessage bridge; PR B = copy + tooltips + placeholder examples + svg lazy-load + inline lint indicator.
Jon: I'll own the copy strings and push JSON diffs to staging by EOD tomorrow.
staging-bot: Deploy: PR 6123 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke 1 tests passed.
Priya: i'll run axe on staging once Jon's copy is up and post any violations.
Iris: thanks all 1 keeping visible labels compact, explicit scope pill, clearer history tense, and a11y fixes. closing for now :thumbsup:
